subject: Ciências
description_pt: Projetar e construir dispositivos para observação à distância (luneta, periscópio etc.), para observação ampliada de objetos (lupas, microscópios) ou para registro de imagens (máquinas fotográficas) e discutir usos sociais desses dispositivos.

components.description_pt: Identificar o princípio óptico por trás de dispositivos usados para observação distante ou ampliada
components.description_en: Identify the optical principle behind devices used for distant or magnified observation

components.description_pt: Construir um dispositivo para observação distante, observação ampliada ou registro de imagens com materiais apropriados
components.description_en: Construct a device for distant observation, magnified observation, or image recording using appropriate materials
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools and materials to build a device that addresses a specified problem

components.description_pt: Explicar como funciona um determinado dispositivo óptico (telescópio, lupa ou câmera)
components.description_en: Explain how a given optical device (telescope, magnifying glass, or camera) functions
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the properties of electromagnetic waves are exploited in a named device or system

components.description_pt: Discutir usos sociais e impactos de dispositivos de observação óptica e registro de imagens
components.description_en: Discuss social uses and impacts of optical observation and image-recording devices
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

cc_matches.description: Use tools and/or materials to design and/or build a device that solves a specific problem or a solution to a specific problem.
Communicate technical information about how some technological devices use the principles of wave behavior and wave interactions with matter to transmit and capture information and energy.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
